WITH step1 AS (
  SELECT tr.ordertypedist, COUNT(*) as cnt
  FROM advancedbehavior ab
  JOIN transactionrecord tr ON tr.transreg = ab.translink
  GROUP BY tr.ordertypedist
),
step2 AS (
  SELECT SUM(cnt) as total FROM step1
),
step3 AS (
  SELECT s1.ordertypedist, s1.cnt, CAST(s1.cnt AS REAL) / s2.total as ratio
  FROM step1 s1 CROSS JOIN step2 s2
),
step4 AS (
  SELECT AVG(ratio) as avg_ratio FROM step3
)
SELECT s3.ordertypedist, s3.cnt, s3.ratio, s3.ratio - s4.avg_ratio as diff
FROM step3 s3 CROSS JOIN step4 s4
WHERE s3.ratio > s4.avg_ratio
ORDER BY s3.ordertypedist
